items.item: Diagnose and fix the S153-caught production LCP regression (/ +97% to 5156ms, /membership/ +193% to 3592ms, both CLS >0.1). Cold/warm cache trace pair + Sentry Performance + RUM webvitals beacon to classify render-blocking vs TTFB vs third-party. Once fixed, gate every deploy on `--detect-regressions` in CI so this class can never silently reach prod again.
items.firstStep: Run cold/warm trace pair via `scripts/measure-page-performance.mjs --check --base=https://vaultsparkstudios.com --routes=/,/membership/ --profiles=desktop:cold,desktop:warm` and diff resource waterfalls; flag any new render-blocking asset added since `data/perf-history.ndjson` median baseline.

items.item: Move IGNIS-driven public personalization (hero copy variant, project ordering, dispatch hooks) from per-request Anthropic calls behind the existing Cloudflare Worker. Worker holds a 12-source-of-truth fingerprint key (trust_tier, hour-of-day, traffic_source, visit_depth, last_dispatch_id, viewport_band, motion-pref, theme, locale, returning_member, sparked_recent_view, oracle_signal_band) → KV cache → 95%+ cache hit → 0 user-perceptible latency + ~95% Anthropic spend reduction on this surface. No SaaS studio runs edge-cached AI personalization keyed on its own canonical signal grid.
items.firstStep: Add `cloudflare/ignis-personalize-worker.js` with KV namespace `IGNIS_PERSONALIZE_CACHE`, fingerprint hash function, and `/api/personalize/:surface` route. Pre-warm 256 most-likely fingerprints via nightly cron.

items.item: VaultCast — a persistent thin top strip (16px, hover to expand) that shows live ambient studio signal across every page: current focus, in-the-forge-right-now session count, last dispatch (≤2h), and live IGNIS cognition delta. Powered by the existing Supabase Realtime channel + `/api/founder-presence.json`. Functionally the live newsroom ticker of a 28-project studio. Nothing else on the web has this — it's brand-on (Oracle = constellation; VaultCast = heartbeat).
items.firstStep: Create `assets/vaultcast-strip.js` that subscribes to `studio_pulse_heartbeat` channel + GET `/api/founder-presence.json`; render before `assets/vault-genome-strip.js`; reserve 16px geometry in critical shell to avoid CLS.

items.item: Synthetic perf (the matrix) tells us local truth; real users tell us prod truth. Ship a 1KB beacon (LCP/FCP/CLS/INP/TTFB + connection + viewport + theme + route + dispatch_seen) to a Cloudflare Worker → R2 → daily rollup → `data/rum-history.ndjson` → wires into `--detect-regressions`. Would have caught the S153 prod regression hours after deploy instead of the next /audit cycle.
items.firstStep: Add `assets/rum-beacon.js` (sub-1KB, deferred, sendBeacon on visibility-hidden); Worker route `/v/rum` → R2 PUT with daily prefix; nightly cron `scripts/rollup-rum.mjs` → ndjson.

items.item: Today the website pulls Studio Ops state via JSON shards. Make it bidirectional: visitor signals worth knowing (search query trends, micro-feedback themes, dispatch reaction patterns, oracle-share clicks) get shipped via Studio Ark cargo (`assets/visitor-signal-ark.js` → Worker → ark inbox) to sibling project repos. A visitor's repeated search for 'Voidfall' becomes cargo addressed to that repo's session-start brief. Closes the public→internal feedback loop the studio doesn't currently have.
items.firstStep: Define ark cargo type `visitor-signal-aggregate` (daily, anonymized); Worker `/v/signal` ingests beacons → KV daily roll → cron ships to ark; receiver-side `vaultspark-studio-ops/scripts/ark-route-visitor-signal.mjs` writes to per-repo `.cache/visitor-signals.json`.

items.item: Current Speculation Rules (S126) prefetch on hover. Upgrade to bandwidth-aware prerender: read `navigator.connection.{effectiveType,saveData}` + `device.memory` + battery + reduced-motion to ladder between `prerender`, `prefetch`, and `none`. On a fast-fiber desktop with 8GB+ RAM, top-3 likely next-navigations prerender on idle = instant. On slow-3G or saveData, prefetch only. Free-tier Cloudflare doesn't charge for prerendered traffic — pure win.
items.firstStep: Replace static `<script type='speculationrules'>` block with `assets/adaptive-speculation.js` that JSON.stringify-injects per-visitor rules based on `navigator.connection`; emit one rules block per page-type signature (home, project, journal, member).

items.item: Turnstile has been the proximate cause of FOUR login regressions (S121/S122/S125/S126). Add passkey/WebAuthn as the primary auth path — passwordless, no captcha, no inline-iframe hash hell, no CSP brittleness, 8× faster median sign-in. Password remains as fallback. Closes a recurring incident class structurally.
items.firstStep: Add Supabase `webauthn_credentials` table + `webauthn_register`/`webauthn_authenticate` RPCs using `@simplewebauthn/server` in an Edge Function; client `vault-member/webauthn.js` calls `navigator.credentials.create/get`; promote 'Use a passkey' button above email/password on `vault-member/`.

items.item: Visitors can ask IGNIS questions about the studio (Ask IGNIS shipped S105). Make it ambient: a corner `whisper` chip — typing it speaks to the founder-twin model (NOT live founder), which answers in twin voice with one provenance link and one suggested next page. Differentiator: it cites EVIDENCE (which dispatch, which commit-cluster, which roadmap entry) instead of hallucinating. Use Max plan via the existing routing — zero Anthropic API spend.
items.firstStep: Add `assets/twin-whisper.js` (collapsed corner chip, expands to chat slab); Edge Function `whisper-twin` uses existing `loadMemberProfile` + new `loadPublicStudioMemory` (dispatches + decisions + currentFocus); enforce one provenance link required in system prompt.

items.item: Performance matrix proves LCP+CLS — INP (Interaction-to-Next-Paint, the 2024+ Core Web Vital that replaced FID) is unmeasured. Budget: INP <200ms on mobile across `/`, `/membership/`, `/oracle/`, `/community/`. Likely culprits: ambient bundle re-renders on theme toggle, oracle-extra crosshair pointermove not throttled, micro-feedback emoji-burst layout thrash. Mobile-first studio + zero INP visibility is a hole.
items.firstStep: Extend `scripts/measure-page-performance.mjs` to script realistic interactions (theme toggle, nav drawer open, oracle hover, micro-feedback submit) and capture `performance.eventCounts` → INP estimate; add budget assertion (200ms p75) to matrix.

items.item: Worker CSP is nonce+strict-dynamic (S120). Next layer: `require-trusted-types-for 'script'` + `trusted-types vs-policy` to structurally eliminate DOM-XSS. All `innerHTML` writes route through a single sanitizer policy. Combined with existing SRI lint + JS-budget gate, this puts the site at top-1% web security posture. Pair with `Reporting-Endpoints` + report-only rollout so violations surface before enforcement.
items.firstStep: Add `assets/trusted-types-policy.js` (one allow-list policy, sanitizes via DOMPurify subset); audit all `innerHTML`/`outerHTML`/`document.write` uses in `assets/*.js` via grep gate; add `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: require-trusted-types-for 'script'` to Worker for 2-week soak.

items.item: Studio Hub is an internal operator surface. Public-safe slice of it (28-project status grid · health colors · last-touch · sparked/forge/vaulted/sealed counts · live session indicator) belongs as `/studio-hub-public/` — gives visitors the same situational awareness operators have, with no operator vocab. Cohesion play with Studio Ops / Hub / Social Dashboard / SparkFunnel — same data, public-voice translation.

items.item: Site search is keyword (S102). Replace with intent routing: typing 'how do I become a member' goes to /membership/ + auto-scrolls to ranks; 'is voidfall a game' goes to /games/voidfall/ + opens project-block; 'who built this' goes to /about/. Powered by twin model with intent→route mapping + 30-row training set + fallback to keyword. Search box becomes the universal entry. Cap: 50ms p95 (KV-cached intents).
items.firstStep: Add `data/intent-routes.json` (50 seed intents → route + scroll target); `assets/search-intent.js` calls `/api/intent-route?q=` Worker → KV lookup → twin fallback for cold intents; logs unmatched intents for weekly review.
